#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

class AntiPalindrome {
public:
    void solve() {
        int N;
        cin >> N;
        vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
        int move = 0;
        string str;
        cin >> str;
        vector<int> b(N);
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            cin >> b[i];
            res += b[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N / 2; ++i) {
            if (str[i] == str[N - i - 1]) {
                cnt[str[i] - 'a']++;
                move++;
                res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
            if (cnt[i] > move / 2) {
                int left = 2 * cnt[i] - move;
                vector<int> pos;
                for (int j = 0; j < N / 2; ++j) {
                    if (str[j] != str[N - j - 1]) {
                        if (str[N - j - 1] - 'a' == i || str[j] - 'a' == i) {
                            // do nothing, skip
                        } else {
                            pos.push_back(min(b[j], b[N - j - 1]));
                        }
                    }
                }
                sort(pos.begin(), pos.end());
                for (int j = 0; j < left && j < (int)pos.size(); ++j) {
                    res -= pos[j];
                }
            }
        }
        cout << res << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    AntiPalindrome solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
